themes_detail.label: Street Infrastructure Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints exploded to 174 THIS WEEK, a 607% spike versus the 8-week baseline of 24.6 complaints per week (z-score: 26.11), suggesting a sudden deterioration in road surfaces across Woodhaven/Richmond Hill that may signal weather damage, deferred maintenance, or a localized failure event requiring immediate investigation.
evidence: 174 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 24.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
607% spike with z-score of 26.11 (extreme statistical anomaly)
Related spike in Street Light Condition complaints (14 THIS WEEK vs. 5.9 avg, +138%)
reporting_angles: Site inspection of worst-affected blocks to document specific street failures and photograph conditions
Interview DOT about emergency repair response and whether this week's complaints correlate to a specific weather event or infrastructure failure

themes_detail.label: Traffic Signal Failures Spiking
themes_detail.summary: Traffic signal condition complaints surged to 156 LAST WEEK, a 675% spike versus the 8-week baseline of 20.1 complaints per week (z-score: 10.03), creating potential safety and traffic flow hazards across the district just as winter weather intensifies.
evidence: 156 traffic signal complaints LAST WEEK vs. 20.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
675% spike with z-score of 10.03 (severe statistical anomaly)
Potential safety risk at major intersections if signals are malfunctioning
reporting_angles: Document non-functioning traffic signals with video/photos at key intersections; quantify commute delays and near-miss incidents reported by drivers
Query NYPD and DOT on accident reports correlated with signal outages and timeline for repairs

themes_detail.label: Illegal Cannabis Retail Surge
themes_detail.summary: Cannabis retailer complaints jumped to 11 LAST WEEK, a 1000% spike versus the 8-week baseline of 1.0 complaint per week (z-score: 10.0), indicating either rapid proliferation of unlicensed dispensaries or sudden resident awareness of compliance violations in Woodhaven/Richmond Hill.
evidence: 11 cannabis retailer complaints LAST WEEK vs. 1.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
1000% spike with z-score of 10.0 (extreme statistical anomaly)
Suggests either new dispensary openings or rapid enforcement awareness among residents
reporting_angles: Map locations of 311-reported unlicensed dispensaries; conduct undercover visits to verify operationality and licensing status
Interview local council member and NYPD about enforcement response; determine if complaints are triggering raids or if establishments are operating openly

themes_detail.label: Tree Damage Spike
themes_detail.summary: Damaged tree complaints spiked to 35 TWO WEEKS AGO, a 600% spike versus the 8-week baseline of 5.0 complaints per week (z-score: 10.0), likely caused by recent heavy weather and suggesting widespread branch failures and falling debris hazards across the district.
evidence: 35 damaged tree complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 5.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
600% spike with z-score of 10.0 (severe statistical anomaly)
Correlates with street condition and street light spikes, suggesting weather-driven infrastructure damage event
reporting_angles: Document tree damage visually in parks and along streets; assess public safety risk from hanging branches
Interview Parks Department on removal timeline and whether backlog exists from this spike

themes_detail.label: Street-Level Noise Escalation
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints surged to 27 THIS WEEK, a 293% spike versus the 8-week baseline of 6.9 complaints per week (z-score: 7.98), suggesting either increased outdoor commercial/construction activity or new vendor operations disrupting residential areas.
evidence: 27 street/sidewalk noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 6.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
293% spike with z-score of 7.98 (high statistical anomaly)
Related spike in Vendor Enforcement complaints (3 complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.2 avg, +1100%), suggesting vendor activity overlap
reporting_angles: Identify specific blocks and times with highest noise 311 complaints; conduct audio monitoring or site visits
Interview residents on whether noise is from construction, street vendors, bars, or other sources
